references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical low lean canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide, ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, compact flame tail. Four legs and distinct lean hound muzzle; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of the same creature. Row 1: 1 ready animal stance; 2 legs fold and chest lowers; 3 belly and chest very low. Row 2: 4 creature tips gently onto its side; 5 head, chest and belly touch the ground; 6 fully still LYING FLAT ON ITS SIDE, head resting on ground, legs relaxed. Keep its intact animal anatomy, no human posture or equipment. The final body lies on the ground, never standing, crouching or sitting. Non-graphic creature collapsing and lying on the ground, no gore, no blood, no injury detail. Each complete creature occupies only HALF its spacious cell, with all tail, horns, antennae and wings inside wide empty gutters. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt: Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy game character animation sprite sheet on uniform solid vivid pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Visually match Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png for character identity, palette, and stylized painterly rendering. Character is an ANIMAL ONLY cinder hound canine creature: charcoal-black cracked stone hide with warm glowing ember seams, angular pointed ears, lean hound muzzle, long jointed four canine legs, compact fiery flame tail. No human anatomy, no clothes, no weapons, no equipment. Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows grid containing 6 sequential collapse animation poses of the same creature at identical scale: Row 1 pose 1: alert ready canine stance; pose 2: legs buckle and fold as chest lowers; pose 3: belly and chest sinking very low near the ground. Row 2 pose 4: tipping gently forward/onto side; pose 5: head, chest, and belly touching the ground; pose 6: completely still, collapsed flat on the ground with head resting and legs relaxed. All 6 poses viewed strictly from an elevated 55-degree orthographic rear-right three-quarter perspective facing diagonally away toward image right, with camera seeing back surfaces and creature collapsing forward away from viewer, face turning away/hidden. Non-graphic collapse with no blood, no gore, intact anatomy. Each pose is comfortably centered within the middle 60% of its spacious equal grid cell, separated by wide empty magenta gutters. No panel frames, no grid borders, no text, no labels, no environment or floor texture, clean pure magenta backdrop. Rich sculpted painterly volumes, cool upper-left directional lighting, subtle contact shadows.
